artifact_hunt._reading: c1_fires_uniformly_flag is the HEADLINE check: _match_trendline has no distance cap of its own (only C4's separate $0.60 test does), and searches ~8 candidate lines fit over a 5-day window, so C1 (+2, 'named_level' via trendline anchor) can fire even when the matched line sits several dollars from spot (see matched_line_gap_dollars.max) -- n_gap_gt_060 counts how many of those matches would NOT also clear C4's OWN proximity bar. concentration_flag/time_of_day_proxy_flag are tripwires, not verdicts -- a flagged result needs the raw credited_pnl_by_date table read by eye before trusting any aggregate.
